title: The Urgent call from the hospital
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：urgent　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 urgent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the builder wrote of ① an urgent call from the hospital in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so urgent that nobody in the site would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the urgent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the urgent call from the hospital that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too urgent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the urgent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an urgent need for the money, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as urgent as the need for the money they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was urgent or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something urgent, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite urgent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the urgent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, in silence, she wrote of another urgent call from the hospital in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less urgent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The urgent need for the money that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the urgent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 紧急（前置定语 an urgent call from the hospital：1983 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件紧急的电话）
B. adj. 紧急／急迫（两处加强说法：so urgent that … 与 no less urgent than …）
C. adj. 紧急／急迫（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 紧急（表语 too urgent to do：母亲觉得它太紧急，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 急迫（前置定语 an urgent need for the money：叔叔把整件事称作一桩急迫的需求）
F. adj. 急迫（同级比较 as urgent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对这笔钱的急迫需求相比）
G. adj. 急迫（后置定语 something urgent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 急迫（受程度副词修饰 quite urgent：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: an urgent call from the hospital
the urgent call from the hospital that
an urgent need for the money
The urgent need for the money that

answers.why: urgent 意为“紧急”，1983 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件紧急的电话”，此处作前置定语 an urgent call from the hospital。
urgent 意为“紧急”，此处用 so urgent that 结构，说它紧急到工地里没人敢靠近。
urgent 意为“紧急”，施工图上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的紧急医院打来的紧急电话，等于最高级的说法。
urgent 意为“紧急”，母亲认为这件东西“太紧急了，谁也用不上”，too urgent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
urgent 意为“急迫”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩急迫的需求”，此处作前置定语 an urgent need for the money。
urgent 意为“急迫”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对这笔钱的急迫需求一样急迫”，同级比较用 as urgent as。
urgent 意为“急迫”，施工图上那半行字要的是“急迫的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something urgent。
urgent 意为“急迫”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当急迫”，quite 修饰原级 urgent。
urgent 意为“急迫”，no less urgent than 表示“其急迫不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之急迫不亚于任何人的预料。
urgent 意为“急迫”，母亲 1995 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的急迫需求”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件紧急的电话。（an urgent call from the hospital）
它紧急到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so urgent that …）
母亲觉得它太紧急，谁也用不上。（too urgent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩急迫的需求。（an urgent need for the money）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对这笔钱的急迫需求一样急迫。（as urgent as …）
到了 1990 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件急迫的东西。（something urgent）
answers: In 1983 the builder wrote of an urgent call from the hospital in the plan.
It was so urgent that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too urgent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an urgent need for the money.
He said nobody would call it as urgent as the need for the money they had once had.
By 1990 the plan asked for nothing but something urgent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 urgent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the builder wrote of an urgent call from the hospital in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the urgent call from the hospital that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too urgent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an urgent need for the money, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite urgent, and everybody laughed.
The urgent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
